hook: Midnight lodge checks: *104* people rounded up in Malakpet, IS Sadan
hook_b: Midnight lodge checks: *104* people rounded up in Malakpet, IS Sadan
tldr: Police searched lodges and hotels in Malakpet and IS Sadan on Monday night and checked guests' ID papers, three days after Hyderabad Police got a bomb-threat email.

beats.what: Malakpet police checked 10 lodges from 10.30 pm to 2 am and rounded up 54 people; IS Sadan police checked six lodges and rounded up 50.
beats.why: Hyderabad Police received a threatening email on November 21 and tightened security across the city.
beats.care: Police say hotels, lodges and other stays across the city are under watch, and owners must keep proper guest records.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: One Malakpet lodge was booked for selling liquor. Police have not officially disclosed what the email said.

cards.q: Have you noticed extra security checks near you this week?

qs: What records must lodges keep on guests?
How long will the city-wide watch on stays continue?

facts.t: Malakpet police checked *10 lodges*; one was booked for selling liquor.

viz.verdict: Malakpet checked 10 lodges, IS Sadan six; nothing suspicious found in IS Sadan

viz.l: people rounded up in two station limits

cover.label: people rounded up in two station limits

learn.t: SHO = Station House Officer, the officer in charge of a police station

watch: Whether police share what the November 21 email said, and whether checks widen to other station limits.

sources.name: Siasat
sources.title: Lodges, hotels under scanner amid 26/11-style bomb threat in Hyderabad

fact: Police checked *16 lodges* overnight in Malakpet and IS Sadan after a threat email
twist: In IS Sadan, the inspector said guests were in town for office work or college admissions; nothing suspicious was found.
